name: Copy.ai
tagline: An early AI copywriting tool that has pivoted into a workflow-driven GTM content platform.
tldr: Copy.ai launched as one of the first GPT-3-powered short-form marketing copy generators and has since repositioned itself as a 'GTM AI Platform' built around workflows and agents, not just a writing app.
Best for marketing and sales teams that want templated, repeatable copy generation plus automated multi-step content/GTM workflows.
Pricing has a free tier (2,000 words/month) and a $29/mo Chat plan, but then jumps sharply to workflow-credit plans starting around $1,000/mo for teams needing automation at scale.
Used by larger brands (e.g. Nestlé, eBay, Salesforce have been cited as customers) alongside solo creators and small marketing teams.
Trustpilot reviews show a notably mixed reputation, with real complaints about billing/cancellation alongside praise for ease of use and content quality.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2,000 words/month, 10 chat credits/month, 200 bonus workflow credits

plans.name: Chat
plans.notes: Unlimited Chat usage; no workflow credits included

plans.name: Agents
plans.notes: Adds workflow credits and additional seats

plans.name: Expansion / Scale / Enterprise
plans.notes: Larger seat counts, workflow credit allocations, API access, guided implementation

pros: Free tier and $29/mo Chat plan make it accessible for solo creators and small teams
Large library of pre-built templates and workflows speeds up common copywriting tasks
Workflow/agent features let teams automate multi-step GTM content processes, not just single documents
Used by recognizable enterprise brands, lending some credibility for team adoption
cons: Steep pricing cliff: after the $29/mo Chat plan, the next tier jumps to roughly $1,000/mo for workflow automation
Trustpilot reviews report billing issues, including charges continuing after cancellation attempts
Support responsiveness is a recurring complaint, with some users describing extended outages and unclear communication
Output still requires editing; AI-generated copy can lack the specific angle or creativity of a human copywriter

sentiment.quote: Easily the best AI copywriting platform in the market. It's easy to use and generates amazing content.
It's a great product but has a very bad team. Every other day it will stop working and the support team (including the founder, Chris Lu) has absolutely no idea about what's going on.
Copy.ai withdraws money from customer bank cards without paying for payment. They withdrew money from my card in 4 months. For these 4 months I did not use the service.

bestFor: Small marketing teams and solo creators who want an affordable Chat-based copy tool
Sales/GTM teams building multi-step automated content workflows
Businesses already using Copy.ai's templates for repeatable social/ad copy
Teams with budget for higher-tier workflow automation (Growth plan and above)
hotTake: Copy.ai rebranded itself from a $29/mo writing app into a 'GTM AI Platform,' but that repositioning comes with a pricing cliff that jumps straight from Chat to roughly $1,000/mo Growth plans.
